description: Find the phone company behind an OCN (operating company number, the 4-character carrier code in the numbering records), or a carrier's OCNs by name. Returns the carrier, company type, the area codes where it holds number blocks, and its block count. Assigned-block data, not live porting.

query.description: An OCN such as "9104", or part of a carrier name such as "Verizon".

name: lookup_ocn
title: Look up a carrier company code (OCN)
